content.text:
﻿metadata:
  udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main
  name: PrismataLabs Main Menu
  version: 0.4.0
  kind: PCMS-Menu

menus:
  - id: menu.main
    key: menu.main
    udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main
    name: PrismataLabs
    title: PrismataLabs
    label: PrismataLabs
    position: Main
    order: 1
    type: main
    icon: "labs"
    colour_scheme: primary-application
    border_scheme: primary-application
    description: PrismataLabs preview environment for UI components.
    finalItemType: Quit

    header:
      udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.header
      text: |
        PrismataLabs Preview
        ---------------------
        Colour Scheme Selected: {{selected.colour_scheme}}
        Border Pattern Selected: {{selected.border_pattern}}
        Object Selected: {{selected.object}}
      style: header
      colour_scheme: header
      border_scheme: header-border
      visibility_mode: static

    footer:
      udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.footer
      text: "0: Quit | Enter: Select"
      style: footer
      colour_scheme: footer
      border_scheme: primary-application
      visibility_mode: static

    items:
      - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.preview-object
        key: "1"
        name: Preview Object
        label: Preview Object
        type: action
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: multi_pane
        capability: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.preview-object
        executeTarget: preview_object
        icon: "preview"
        colour_scheme: default
        description: Render a preview of the selected object.
        visibility_mode: static
        enable_mode: conditional
        enable_condition: selected.object is not None

      - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.validate-preview
        key: "2"
        name: Validate Preview
        label: Validate Preview
        type: action
        order: 2
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: basic
        capability: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.validate-preview
        executeTarget: validate_preview
        icon: "validate"
        colour_scheme: default
        description: Validate the loaded object using canonical schema rules.
        visibility_mode: static
        enable_mode: conditional
        enable_condition: selected.object is not None

      - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.select-load
        key: "3"
        name: Select & Load Object(s)
        label: Select & Load Object(s)
        type: action
        order: 3
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: structured_editor
        capability: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.select-load
        executeTarget: select_load_objects
        icon: "load"
        colour_scheme: default
        description: Select colour-schemes, border-patterns, panes, menus, or ui-frameworks.
        visibility_mode: static
        enable_mode: enabled

      - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.default-folders
        key: "4"
        name: Default Folder Path(s)
        label: Default Folder Path(s)
        type: action
        order: 4
        selectionMethod: number
        action: execute
        ui_framework: basic
        capability: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.default-folders
        executeTarget: configure_default_folders
        icon: "settings"
        colour_scheme: default
        description: Configure default search paths for previewable objects.
        visibility_mode: static
        enable_mode: enabled

      - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.menu.main.quit
        key: "0"
        name: Quit
        label: Quit
        type: action
        order: 5
        selectionMethod: number
        action: exit
        ui_framework: basic
        capability: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.app-quit
        executeTarget: exit_application
        icon: "quit"
        colour_scheme: default
        description: Exit PrismataLabs.
        visibility_mode: static
        enable_mode: enabled
